# State scope: Lerendor or one of its subjects controls the state.
zin_leren_state_held = {
	controller = {
		OR = {
			original_tag = Y0G
			is_subject_of = Y0G
		}
	}
}

# Lerendor's own shore holds the strait: Sonargur and every state of the Leren shore (enough to close it, O9).
zin_leren_guards_strait = {
	country_exists = Y0G
	any_state = {
		zin_is_site_sonargur = yes
		zin_leren_state_held = yes
	}
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			zin_is_site_strait_north = yes
			NOT = { zin_leren_state_held = yes }
		}
	}
}

# The whole strait: also R'en's coast (O9).
zin_leren_holds_strait = {
	zin_leren_guards_strait = yes
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			zin_is_site_strait_gateway = yes
			NOT = { zin_leren_state_held = yes }
		}
	}
}

# The hook for the Zol slice: Lerendor holds the strait, fights Zol and has the capes held.
zin_leren_strait_barred = {
	zin_leren_holds_strait = yes
	Y0G = {
		has_war_with = Y0U
		OR = {
			has_completed_focus = zin_lerendor_hold_the_capes
			has_completed_focus = zin_lerendor_the_watch_holds
		}
	}
}
